game.rules:
# Platforms

- All official platforms (N64, VC, iQue) are allowed.
- Flashcarts (i.e. Everdrive) are allowed.
- Approved emulators are allowed (see list below).
- Unapproved emulators are banned.
- Using modified ROMs is banned.

The following emulators are approved:

- mupen64plus
- Rosalie's Mupen GUI (RMG)
- Simple64
- Ares N64 Core
- OpenEmu N64 Core

Also, here are some recommended plugins:

- Video: Parallel (ParaLLel-RDP)
- RSP: Parallel (ParaLLel-RSP)

categories.name: 3 Lap
categories.rules:
# 3 Lap

**Gameplay**

- Any rider may be used. 
- Custom watercraft settings are allowed. 
- Default wave settings must be used.
- Using the Retire option disqualifies the run. 
- Pausing during a run measured in in-game time invalidates the run. This includes accessing the menu in Virtual Console and other ways of pausing the game.

**TIming**

- The in-game timer is used.

**Submissions**

- Version information is required for all submissions.
- Captured video proof is required for all top 10 submissions. Captured means the video must be captured from a capture card (e.g. GV-USB2, EasyCap, Elgato), not from a webcam, phone, or similar.
- Video proof of some kind is required for all benchmarks. Benchmark times are times with the same to-the-second reading as the 3rd place run (or better), or lap times with the same half-second reading as 3rd place run (or better). Examples: race times faster than 1'04"000 and lap times faster than 20"500 on Sunny Beach (forward) require video proof.
- Video proof must include the results screen showing the course leaderboard.
- Runs may be rejected on the basis of insufficient video proof quality, based on factors including but not limited to: excessive framedrops, poor resolution, lack of audio, general illegibility, etc. Adding contact information to your speedrun.com account is recommended to avoid verification delays if there is any question about your run.

categories.name: Championship Normal
categories.rules:
# Championship Normal

**Gameplay**

- Default wave settings must be used.
- Using the Retire option disqualifies the run. 

**Run TIming**

- Both IGT and RTA timings are required.
- IGT is the primary timing and is used for the official rankings.  It is calculated by summing the in-game times for each level in the championship.
- RTA is the secondary timing and is rounded down to the whole second.  RTA timing begins at either the character select (when you push A or Start the last time and it starts the championship) OR when you select restart from the championship pause screen.  RTA timing ends on the frame you cross the finish line on Southern Island.

**Video Proof**

- Captured video proof is required for all videos to receive verification. Captured means the video must be captured from a capture card (e.g. GV-USB2, EasyCap, Elgato), not from a webcam, phone, or similar.
- Video must include the final timescroll (the scrolling list of times set during the run that plays after each championship is completed).
- Runs may be rejected on the basis of insufficient video proof quality, based on factors including but not limited to: excessive framedrops, poor resolution, lack of audio, general illegibility, etc. Adding contact information to your speedrun.com account is recommended to avoid verification delays if there is any question about your run.

categories.name: All Championships
categories.rules:
# All Championships

**Gameplay**

- Complete all championships in order without retiring or turning off/resetting the system.
- Championships must be run in the following order: Normal, Hard, Expert, Reverse.
- Default wave settings must be used.
- Using the Retire option disqualifies the run. 
- Resetting the console disqualifies the run.

**Run TIming**

- Both IGT and RTA timings are required.
- IGT is the primary timing and is used for the official rankings.  It is calculated by summing the in-game times for each level in the championship.
- RTA is the secondary timing and is rounded down to the whole second.  RTA timing begins on reset or console power on.  RTA timing ends on the frame you cross the finish line on Southern Island Reverse.

**Video Proof**

- Captured video proof is required for all videos to receive verification. Captured means the video must be captured from a capture card (e.g. GV-USB2, EasyCap, Elgato), not from a webcam, phone, or similar.
- Video must include all final timescrolls (the scrolling list of times set during the run that plays after each championship is completed).
- Runs may be rejected on the basis of insufficient video proof quality, based on factors including but not limited to: excessive framedrops, poor resolution, lack of audio, general illegibility, etc. Adding contact information to your speedrun.com account is recommended to avoid verification delays if there is any question about your run.
